headline._readme: Identity overlay for the Headline base (COLLECTION.md s8): merges, rejects, desk moves, never_merge. Desk moves label the regional desks' rows asia / brazil (decisions.md D2 Asia, D3 Brazil; since Erik's E1 of 2026-09-28 the label no longer excludes them): a row the CMS lists only under the Asia or Brazil fund page, or only by that desk's investors. A row with a home fund page (US, EU, Global Growth) stays.

merges.name: Honeycomb
merges.reason: one company: Hound Technology, Inc. is Honeycomb.io's legal name (Form D issuer; Gieselmann on the filing, Honeycomb on his team page)

merges.name: Nom Nom
merges.reason: one company: NomNomNow Inc. is Nom Nom's legal name (Form D 2018, Gieselmann; Nom Nom on his team page; acquired by Mars 2022)

merges.name: Blossom Health
merges.reason: one company: Blossom BH OpCo Inc. is Blossom Health's operating company (Form D 2025, Schilling; Blossom Health on his team page)

merges.name: Angie's List
merges.reason: one investment: BV Capital Fund II held Angie's List (Form 3 at the 2011 IPO; bvcapital.com 2008-2010); Angie's List merged into IAC's ANGI Homeservices in 2017, renamed Angi Inc. in 2021, which the 2026 site lists as 'Angi'

merges.name: Expertcity
merges.reason: one investment: Expertcity (GoToMyPC, later GoToMeeting) was the BV Capital company, bought by Citrix in 2004 and run as Citrix Online (bvcapital.com 'Expertcity (CTXS)'; Wikipedia: 'Investors included ... Bertelsmann Ventures'); the 2026 team pages list it by its product 'GoToMeeting'

merges.name: Homa
merges.reason: one company: the CMS carries Homa Games twice ('Homa' on the EU and growth fund pages, 'Homa Games' under Jonathan Userovici); Homa is the current brand

merges.name: Mine
merges.reason: one company: Mine (saymine.com), Tel Aviv; the CMS carries it as 'Mine' on the grid and 'Saymine' under Christian Miele

merges.name: CodeSignal
merges.reason: one company: BrainFights, Inc. is CodeSignal's legal name (CodeFights, founded 2015 by Tigran Sloyan; Form D 2015-2016, Gieselmann director; CodeSignal on his team page)

merges.name: Housecall Pro
merges.reason: one company: Codefied Inc. does business as Housecall Pro (Form D 2013-2022, Gieselmann director; 4180 Wynkoop Street, Denver, the address on the firm's CMS)

merges.name: Merchantry
merges.reason: one company: EDGAR CIK 1502734 renamed Ixtens, Inc. to Merchantry, Inc. (same registrant, 355 Lexington Avenue, New York; Gieselmann director on both)

merges.name: Voicea
merges.reason: one company: Rizio, Inc. is Voicea's legal name ('Rizio dba Voicea'; Menlo Park Form Ds 2016-2018, Schilling director); acquired by Cisco 2019

merges.name: Recursive
merges.reason: one company: 'Superintelligence' on Christian Miele's team page is Recursive Superintelligence, the London company the CMS lists as 'Recursive' (Early 2026, Miele)

merges.name: Helcim
merges.reason: one company: 'Helcium' on Mathias Schilling's team page (a title-only doc created 2026-08-31) is a misspelling of Helcim, the Calgary payments company on the US fund page (founder Nic Beique)

merges.name: Test.ai
merges.reason: one company: Appdiff renamed itself test.ai (the e.ventures site swapped Appdiff.png for TestAI.png in October 2018)

merges.name: Classbox
merges.reason: one company: the Classbox team (Wang Ran, Li Tianfang) closed its earlier product Jihua.fm (计划FM) in 2012 to focus on Classbox (课程格子) (Jiemian); both logos sat on the e.ventures wall for the same Asia-desk investment (E1 research, 2026-09-28)

merges.name: RD Station
merges.reason: one company: Resultados Digitais renamed itself RD Station in December 2020 (TOTVS bought it in 2021); the firm's CMS carries both a grid doc (Resultados Digitais) and a hidden doc (RD Station) for one Brazil-desk investment (E1 research, 2026-09-28)
